title: FileVerification
description: 200 body of POST /api/v1/sessions/{sid}/files/{fid}/complete (FR-09/10). `sha256` is the lowercase hex SHA-256 the receiver computed over the reassembled file. A mismatch is reported as 422 VERIFY_FAILED, not as verified=false. Mirrors FileVerification in packages/libreshare_core/lib/src/model/session_models.dart. Unknown members MUST be ignored.
